jobDescription:
Hiring for our esteemed client

What you will do (Immediate Joiners only)

We are seeking a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer to design, develop and deploy machine learning models and AI-driven solutions. You will work closely with clients, software engineers and product teams to transform data into actionable insights and intelligent applications.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build agentic AI systems - tool use, multi-agent orchestration, ReAct/chain-of-thought pipelines.
  • Develop and deploy LLM-powered features: RAG pipelines, autonomous workflow automation.
  • Own prompt engineering and context engineering: manage context windows, token budgets, and output structuring.
  • Build and maintain backend services using Python and FastAPI; design and manage relational databases with SQLAlchemy and Alembic migrations.
  • Host and serve custom models on AWS SageMaker; manage endpoints, scaling, and inference pipelines.
  • Work with open-source models via Hugging Face - model selection, inference, and lightweight customisation.
  • Set up and maintain ML/AI-Ops workflows - CI/CD pipelines for model deployment, automated testing, and continuous delivery of AI features.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in ML, AI, deep learning, and agentic frameworks.

Must have

  • 4+ years of experience in Python (3.10+) clean, production-grade code with async patterns and FastAPI.
  • GenAI fundamentals: solid understanding of tokens, embeddings, prompt engineering, and context engineering.
  • Familiarity with Agent-to-Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Basic ML/NLP knowledge: classification, regression, NLP pipelines, BERT, LIWC, Bag of Words, and embedding-based similarity models.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and hosting custom models on AWS SageMaker.
  • Familiarity with the Hugging Face ecosystem and open-source model landscape.
  • Experience with ML/AIOps - CI/CD pipelines for model lifecycle, model versioning, monitoring, and automated evaluation in production.
  • Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.

Job Summary

All roles at JumpCloud are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

Role Overview

As a Software Engineer II on the Auth Access team, you will contribute to building, scaling, and maintaining the core authentication and identity services that power the JumpCloud platform. You will work closely with a globally distributed engineering team to deliver reliable features across our Go, Python, and Node.js backend stacks.

This role focuses heavily on implementing modern, secure web authentication protocols, integrating seamless identity workflows, and aggressively leveraging AI-assisted development tools (like GitHub Copilot and Cursor) to write high-quality code and accelerate feature velocity.

What You Will Do

  • Backend Development: Develop, test, and deploy scalable, secure, and well-documented microservices using Go, Python, and/or Node.js.
  • Auth Identity Implementation: Write and maintain backend code supporting core Auth/IAM technologies, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JSON Web Tokens (JWT), and single sign-on (SSO) flows.
  • AI-Driven Efficiency: Actively utilize AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to automate code generation, write robust automated unit tests, and speed up debugging cycles.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Work with containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and deploy cloud-native services across AWS Cloud Services (EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB).
  • Quality Automation: Design automated test cases for both new features and legacy services, utilizing CI/CD pipelines to enforce automated quality gates.
  • Collaborative Engineering: Partner with product managers and senior engineers across multiple time zones to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility, and participate in thorough code reviews.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 3-5 years of professional experience in software development, with a strong emphasis on backend systems and API development.
  • Core Technical Stack: Proficiency in Go, Node.js, and/or Python.
  • Authentication Foundations: A solid understanding of modern web security and authentication architectures, specifically OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and JWT.
  • Cloud DevOps Basics: Practical experience deploying software on AWS and a functional understanding of container orchestration (Kubernetes) or Infrastructure as Code concepts (Terraform).
  • AI Tool Fluent: Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants to increase individual velocity, track down bugs, and improve overall code quality.

Location

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role. There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected to be ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

Language

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

As a Solutions Architect (Documentation), youre turn project details handed to you by the delivery team into that documentation. Youre not designing the architecture, youre the one making sure its written up to the standard AWS requires, consistently, engagement after engagement. AI tools are fair game for drafting; the bar is on accuracy and whether it passes review.

What you ll do

  • Create documentation aligned with the AWS Competency and Service Delivery Program requirements, using project and architecture details provided by the delivery team.
  • Produce the technical validation write-ups, architecture diagrams, and case study documentation AWS requires for Competency and Partner Program reviews.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate drafting, while owning the accuracy and review-readiness of the final document.
  • Keep documentation format and quality consistent across engagements and competencies.
  • Flag gaps in the project details youre given when theyre not sufficient to produce audit-ready documentation.
  • Work against fixed deadlines tied to Partner Program renewal and review cycles.

What we re looking for

  • 2-3 years of experience in technical documentation, solutions architecture, or a related AWS-focused role.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services and architecture concepts enough to read a design and document it accurately.
  • Strong technical writing skills; comfortable turning raw project detail into a document that reads cleanly to an external reviewer.
  • Familiarity with diagramming tools (draw.io, Lucidchart, or similar) for architecture diagrams.
  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of a documentation workflow, without leaning on them for accuracy you havent verified.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to hold a deadline without supervision.

Develops AI-powered construction takeoff, estimating, bid management, and BIM software that automates preconstruction workflows for contractors and field service businesses.

  • Perform 2D and 3D LiDAR point cloud annotation, Cuboid Annotation, and Object Tracking.
  • Identify and classify defects in industrial equipment and infrastructure.
  • Ensure annotation consistency, completeness, and accuracy across all assigned datasets.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Experience with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Strong product mindset with the ability to translate requirements into technical solutions
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments

  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)

Impact

Passion for AI Innovation

You are deeply excited about the transformative potential of AI and committed to contributing to a company shaping the future of work. With curiosity and a growth mindset, you continuously seek to learn, adapt, and stay at the forefront of new developments. Your enthusiasm for innovation drives you to explore new ideas, challenge the status quo, and find creative solutions that deliver meaningful impact. You approach your work with energy and a desire to advance both technology and the way we work.

Job Title: Threat Intelligence Analyst - Associate

Location: Mumbai, India

Corporate Title: AS

Role Description

  • The Threat Intelligence Analyst role sits within the Threat Intelligence function in the Chief Security Office (CSO), which works to proactively detect and disrupt physical and cyber threats against Deutsche Bank as part of its mission to be a threat-driven organisation. This role is primarily focused on physical threat intelligence, while remaining aligned with the broader threat intelligence mandate.
  • The Physical Threat Intelligence Analyst is responsible for proactively identifying, monitoring, analysing, and assessing physical security threats that could affect the organisation s people, assets, operations, reputation, and overall resilience. The role requires systematic collection and evaluation of intelligence from a broad range of sources, including open-source reporting, vendor intelligence, professional networks, and internal stakeholders. By monitoring global, regional, and local risk developments, the analyst produces timely, actionable, and clearly articulated threat assessments that support security operations, executive decision-making, crisis management, incident response, and business continuity planning. This position plays a critical role in helping the organisation anticipate emerging risks, understand their potential business impact, and implement appropriate mitigation measures in a dynamic threat environment.
  • This is an emerging leadership role suited to a candidate with prior experience managing intelligence analysts, developing team capability, and delivering time-sensitive intelligence products in support of Regional Intelligence Analysts across Deutsche Bank.
  • In addition to producing high-quality analysis, the candidate will lead the Information Processing & Research team (IPR), an internal team formed within the Threat Intelligence function. The IPR team transforms structured and unstructured data from multiple sources into high-quality intelligence, enabling data-driven threat identification and informed decision-making through robust collection and validation processes. The team partners with regional analysts through an intelligence-led approach to deliver actionable insights and identify key threat drivers, trends, and patterns across relevant areas of focus.

What we ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you ll enjoy

  • Best in class leave policy
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

  • Threat Monitoring and Intelligence Collection
    • Identify, monitor, and report on geopolitical, regional, and local developments that may affect business operations, personnel, facilities, executive travel, and critical assets.
    • Collect and assess threat intelligence from HUMINT and OSINT sources, including vendors, professional networks, industry associations, social media, news feeds, commercial intelligence platforms, and other relevant sources.
    • Monitor physical security threats, including terrorism, crime, civil unrest, political instability, insider threats, targeted violence, and other emerging risk indicators.
  • Analysis, Reporting, and Intelligence Products
    • Conduct geopolitical, regional, and country risk analysis to identify emerging threats, operational impacts, trends, patterns, and relevant threat actors.
    • Produce timely intelligence reports, alerts, threat assessments, watchlists, and risk dashboards for stakeholders, leadership teams, and operational partners.
    • Deliver tactical and strategic intelligence through verbal briefings, presentations, written reports, and executive-level recommendations that support risk mitigation strategies.
  • Crisis, Incident, and Business Continuity Support
    • Provide time-critical intelligence during crisis events, emergencies, business continuity incidents, and security incidents to support informed decision-making and operational response.
    • Actively engage with crisis management teams and support security incident investigations through intelligence collection, analysis, and reporting.
  • Collaboration, Methodology, and Standards
    • Collaborate with Corporate Security, Global Security Operations Centers, crisis management teams, information security operations, and external security partners.
    • Maintain intelligence databases, analytical methodologies, and reporting standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality across intelligence products.

Your skills and experience

  • Subject-Matter Expertise
    • Strong knowledge of global geopolitics, international relations, and regional security dynamics, with particular focus on Asia Pacific and South Asia.
    • Experience in corporate intelligence operations, including coverage of terrorism, political and social unrest, epidemiological developments, natural hazards, and other relevant security risks.
  • Analytical Capability and Intelligence Production
    • Sound understanding of the intelligence life cycle, including collection, validation, analysis, production, and dissemination.
    • Ability to identify trends, patterns, threat actors, and indicators that may affect organisational operations, personnel, facilities, executive travel, and critical assets.
    • Ability to prepare clear intelligence products, executive-level briefings, and recommendations that support practical risk mitigation.
  • Tools, Sources, and Methodology
    • Experience using open-source intelligence, social media monitoring, news feeds, commercial intelligence platforms, and other relevant sources to identify threat indicators.
    • Experience maintaining intelligence databases, analytical methodologies, and reporting standards would be advantageous.
  • Stakeholder Engagement and Operational Support
    • Experience working with incident response, crisis management, business continuity, or security operations teams.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly and effectively to English-speaking stakeholders.

Character/Professionalism

  • Professional Judgement and Integrity
    • Demonstrates a high level of personal integrity, initiative, objectivity, and professionalism.
    • Maintains sound judgement and composure under pressure while remaining focused on required operational outcomes.
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Builds effective working relationships and demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to influence, collaborate, and negotiate constructively.
    • Works effectively in high-performing, multicultural, and globally distributed teams.
  • Ownership, Delivery, and Development
    • Takes ownership of tasks, prioritises effectively, and delivers high-quality outputs within strict deadlines.
    • Works independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability for outcomes.
    • Demonstrates commitment to ongoing professional development and to building capability in line with role requirements.

Qualifications

  • Education and Professional Experience
    • Master s degree in a relevant field, such as political science, international relations, history, security studies, or related discipline.
    • At least five years of experience in the security industry, geopolitical intelligence, threat intelligence, or a related analytical field.
    • Experience in the financial services industry would be advantageous.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Job Summary

We are growing our Site Reliability Engineering team with a Senior Officer, Site Reliability Engineer who will help make the applications and services behind our products measurably more reliable. Our SRE team brings together engineers who care about instrumentation, incident response and the health of production systems, all working toward a common mission: giving product and engineering teams the observability, guardrails and operational practices they need to run their services with confidence.

This role is for an SRE who comes from an application engineering background. You will spend your time close to the code and the telemetry it produces: instrumenting services with OpenTelemetry, building the dashboards, SLOs and alerts that tell us when something is wrong, and digging into application behaviour when it is. Expect to read and debug code in a stack such as .NET, Java, Node.js or Python, follow a request through HTTP, gRPC, queues and databases, and work out where latency, errors or resource exhaustion are actually coming from, then work with the owning team to fix it properly rather than restart it again.

Our platform runs around the clock and so does the team behind it. On-call coverage moves naturally across time zones as the day progresses. This position anchors the London (GMT/BST) window of that follow-the-sun rotation, and as part of it you should expect to step in on weekends from time to time.

This is a strong fit for an experienced individual contributor who has built and operated production software, enjoys the discipline of measuring reliability rather than guessing at it, and wants to deepen their expertise in site reliability engineering within a regulated financial services environment.

jobDescription:
Hello, We are Hiring Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships at Link Publishers Pvt. Ltd

Experience: 3 5 Years
Department: Sales & Partnerships
Location: Ahmedabad
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships who can identify and build partnerships with SEO products, SaaS platforms, agencies, and other digital marketing businesses.

The primary responsibility of this role is to identify companies where the Link Publishers API can be integrated into their existing product or where our platform can be offered as a white-label link-building solution under the partners own brand.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on mass cold outreach. We are looking for someone who can research a product, understand how it works, identify where Link Publishers fits into its ecosystem, and then approach the right decision-maker with a personalized partnership proposition.

Key Responsibilities 1. Identify API Partnership Opportunities

Research and identify SEO tools, SaaS products, marketing platforms, backlink tools, content platforms, AI SEO tools, agency software, and other relevant products where the Link Publishers API can add value.

You will be expected to:

1/ Understand what the target product does and who its customers are.
2/ Explore the product, website, features, pricing, and existing integrations.
3/ Identify where link-building capabilities can fit naturally into the product.
4/ Develop a clear use case for integrating the Link Publishers API.
5/ Identify the right companies based on partnership potential rather than simply building large prospect lists.

For example, if an SEO platform helps users identify backlink opportunities but doesnt provide a way to actually purchase or execute those placements, you should be able to identify how Link Publishers can potentially fill that gap through an API integration.

2. Build White-Label Partnerships

Identify companies that want to offer link-building services to their customers without building their own publisher network or fulfillment infrastructure.

The goal is to position Link Publishers as their backend link-building partner while they continue selling the service under their own brand name.

Potential partners may include:

1/ SEO agencies
2/ Digital marketing agencies
3/ SaaS companies
4/ SEO platforms
5/ Content marketing platforms
6/ Reseller businesses
7/ Enterprise SEO service providers

You will understand their existing business model and propose a white-label partnership that makes commercial sense for both companies.

3. CXO & Decision-Maker Outreach

Identify and connect with relevant decision-makers, including:

Founders, Co-Founders, CEOs, CMOs, Heads of SEO, Heads of Partnerships, Product Heads, Business Heads, and other senior stakeholders.

The role requires thoughtful outreach rather than sending generic templates.

Before contacting a prospect, you should understand:

What does their company do Where can Link Publishers fit What value can we add Who is the right person to approach What should the partnership proposal look like

4. Personalized Email Outreach

Strong email writing is one of the most important requirements for this position.

You should be able to research a product and write a personalized email explaining exactly how an API integration or white-label partnership could benefit their business.

We are not looking for generic emails such as:

"We provide link-building services and would love to explore a partnership."

Instead, outreach should demonstrate that you have understood the prospects product and identified a genuine integration opportunity.

Emails should be concise, personalized, commercially relevant, and written to generate conversations with senior decision-makers.

5. Partnership Discussions & Closure

Once a prospect shows interest, you will own the partnership conversation from initial discussion to closure.

This includes:

1/ Understanding the partners requirements
2/ Conducting discovery calls
3/ Presenting relevant API/white-label solutions
4/ Coordinating product demonstrations
5/ Discussing commercial models
6/ Coordinating technical discussions with internal teams
7/ Following up with stakeholders
8/ Managing NDA/documentation requirements
9/ Moving opportunities toward integration and launch

You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding how APIs work from a business and product perspective.

What Were Looking For

Experience: 3 5 years in Partnerships, Business Development, SaaS Sales, Strategic Alliances, API Partnerships, SEO SaaS, or a similar role.

The ideal candidate should have:

1/ Strong understanding of SaaS products and online business models.
2/ Good understanding of SEO and link building.
3/ Ability to research and understand new products independently.
4/ Ability to identify API integration opportunities.
5/ Experience communicating with founders and CXO-level stakeholders.
6/ Excellent written English and email communication.
7/ Strong personalization and cold outreach skills.
8/ Ability to convert product research into a compelling partnership proposition.
9/ Confidence conducting discovery and partnership calls.
10/ Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills.
11/ Commercial mindset and ability to think beyond traditional sales.

Technical Understanding

You do not need to code for this role.

However, you should understand basic concepts such as:

API integrations, SaaS platforms, data exchange, product integrations, white-label solutions, marketplaces, and reseller models.

You should be able to communicate a potential integration use case clearly enough for product and technical teams to take the discussion forward.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of emails sent.

We will primarily look at the quality and business impact of partnerships generated, including:

Relevant companies identified Decision-makers contacted Qualified partnership conversations API/White-label opportunities Commercial discussions Signed partnerships Successful integrations

The objective is to build long-term distribution and technology partnerships that allow Link Publishers inventory and link-building capabilities to reach customers through other products and brands.

About Link Publishers

Link Publishers is a link-building marketplace that connects businesses, agencies, and SEO professionals with publishers across multiple industries and markets.

Through our API and white-label solutions, partners can integrate link-building capabilities into their own products or offer link-building services under their own brand while Link Publishers supports the inventory and fulfillment from the backend.

We are looking for someone who can identify where these partnerships make sense and turn those opportunities into scalable business relationships.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team to partner with our product and business stakeholders across risk, operations, and other domains. We are looking for someone who thrives in taking on complex data infrastructure problems with the initiative, problem-solving, and curiosity needed to build reliable and scalable solutions. This role will focus on building robust data pipelines and engineering foundations by ingesting data from disparate sources, ensuring data quality and consistency, and enabling better business decisions through reliable data infrastructure across core product areas.
This is the perfect opportunity for an individual passionate about data engineering, who has the drive to solve complex technical problems and has the ability to grow alongside our team and our company. The ideal candidate can quickly identify data quality issues and bottlenecks, develop creative engineering solutions, and demonstrate the ability to effectively communicate technical decisions to stakeholders. We are seeking someone who is comfortable collaborating directly with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and strategically architect and implement data solutions especially when the path forward isnt fully defined. This will include data pipeline development, data modeling, orchestration design, infrastructure automation, and data quality monitoring.

  • Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines using Airflow to orchestrate data workflows that ingest, transform, and deliver data from various sources into Snowflake and Databricks.
  • Designing and implementing data models in Snowflake that support analytics, reporting, and ML use cases with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Developing infrastructure as code using Terraform to automate and manage cloud resources in AWS, ensuring consistent and reproducible deployments.

  • Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data warehouses like Snowflake, including performance optimization and data modeling.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, IAM, etc.), and understanding of cloud-based data architectures.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with data analysts, analytics engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
  • An ownership mentality - this engineer will be responsible for the reliability and performance of their data pipelines and expected to fully understand data flows, dependencies, and their implications on downstream users.
  • A proactive mindset. While work is assigned, engineers are expected to independently drive their work forward, ask thoughtful questions, and bring structure to ambiguous technical problems.

  • Familiarity with Databricks for large-scale data processing, including Spark optimization and Delta Lake.

  • Azure Synapse

descriptionFromApi:
Role Purpose

The Staff Applications Engineer will support Renesas input protection products for enterprise, data center, AI server, telecom, and industrial power systems. This is a hands-on hardware role focused on customer support, board debug, validation, reference designs, and practical design guidance and requires strong power electronics experience . The engineer will work with systems, design, validation, product marketing, field teams, and customers to solve real application issues and help customers adopt Renesas power products successfully.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provide applications support for input protection devices used in 48 V and emerging 800 V / 400 V power systems.
  • Support customers and field teams through schematic reviews, PCB layout reviews, component selection, bench debug, issue reproduction, root cause analysis, and clear design recommendations.
  • Develop and validate evaluation boards, demo boards, proof of concept hardware, and reference designs for high current and high voltage applications.
  • Debug hardware, register configuration, PMBus/I C communication, gate drive behavior, isolation interfaces, system transients, and customer board failures.
  • Use lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, high voltage supplies, electronic loads, power analyzers, thermal tools, differential probes, and automated test setups.
  • Create scripts, calculators, GUI utilities, and data analysis tools to support validation, characterization, and customer debug.
  • Support new silicon bring up, identify application gaps early, and work with design and systems teams to improve product robustness.
  • Review and write customer documentation such as datasheets, application notes, user guides, design guides, test reports, troubleshooting notes, and training material.
  • Work closely with marketing, systems, design, validation, quality, sales, and field teams to support product launch, customer design in, and issue closure.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field; bachelor s degree with strong relevant experience may also be considered.
  • 3+ years of experience in applications engineering, field applications, validation, product engineering, or hardware development for analog or power semiconductor products.
  • Strong hands-on board and system debug experience, including issue reproduction, waveform analysis, fault isolation, root cause troubleshooting, and corrective action recommendations.
  • Good understanding of power electronics, input protection, MOSFETs gate drive, current sensing, thermal behavior, and protection concepts.
  • Experience with schematic capture, PCB layout review, board bring up, high current routing, grounding, noise coupling, isolation, and measurement best practices.
  • Familiarity with simulation tools such as PSpice, SIMPLIS, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar tools for power, transient, thermal, or signal/power integrity analysis.
  • Comfortable using common lab equipment, including oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, power analyzers, thermal cameras, probes, and solder/rework tools.
  • Able to write clear customer facing documents and work directly with customers and cross-functional engineering teams. Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications / Desired Experience

  • Experience with high voltage products, 800 V or 400 V HVDC systems, solid state relays, eFuses, live insertion, or high power data center systems.
  • Knowledge of PMBus/I C telemetry, register configuration, fault logging, GUI tools, and lab automation using Python, C/C++, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar tools.
  • Experience validating startup into large capacitance, short circuit behavior, load transients, retry/latch off behavior, and safe operating area limits.
  • Familiarity with isolation concepts, isolated interfaces, bias supplies, HV lab safety, EMI, and ESD considerations.
  • Experience creating EVMs, reference designs, demo platforms, user guides, application notes, design calculators, and training material.
  • Customer facing experience with enterprise or data center customers, server OEMs/ODMs, hyperscalers, telecom customers, or field applications teams.

Able to manage ambiguity, prioritize customer issues, and drive practical solutions with limited day to day direction.

Role - Senior/ Associate/ Lead - Test Automation Engineer

Experience : 4 - 12 years

Location : Mumbai/ Bangalore

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Associate Lead QA Engineer / Principal QA Engineer who will function as a senior individual contributor while influencing test architecture, quality strategy, and best practices across teams. The role demands deep hands-on expertise in UI, API, Database, Automation, and AI/LLM testing, with the ability to design scalable test approaches for modern applications.

1. Core QA & Testing Fundamentals:

  • Manual testing (functional, regression, smoke, sanity)

  • UI/UX validation across browsers & devices

  • Strong understanding of test design techniques & defect lifecycle

  • Test Strategy & planning: Develop comprehensive test plans and strategies for web applications, APIs, cloud services,

  • Test Data Management: Test data creation, management, and cleanup strategies

  • Experience in prompt testing, multi-turn flow validation & LLM response evaluation

  • Model evaluation concepts (accuracy, precision, recall, hallucination detection)

  • Data validation within ML pipelines

Good-to-Have Skills

  • ETL/ELT validation (Airflow, dbt, Spark)

  • Strong SQL for backend/database testing

2. Performance /Load Testing

3. 2-3 years working on cloud - Azure or AWS

4. 3-5 years of Experience working in Healthcare domain


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead Automation Framework Design: Architect and govern robust UI and API automation frameworks (Playwright/Selenium), integrated with CI/CD pipelines and designed for long-term maintainability.

  • Own AI & Agentic System Testing: Define testing approaches for AI agents and LLM-based features, including response validation, hallucination detection, bias checks, prompt behavior, and multi-agent workflows.

  • Mentor & Coach QA Teams: Mentor senior testers and automation engineers, review designs and code, and uplift team capability in modern testing, automation, and AI quality practices.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us !

Job Summary

Apply machine learning to route intelligence, demand signals, and control-tower decision support turning logistics data into predictions operators can trust.

3+ years - Remote / India - Full-time

Role Overview

Logibees AI Route Intelligence and control-tower capabilities depend on models that understand demand, constraints, and real-world variability. As an AI Engineer, you will design and productionize ML solutions that help planners and dispatchers make faster, better decisions.

You will partner with platform engineers and product leaders to move models from experiment to reliable services with clear evaluation, monitoring, and iteration loops.

ML models ETA predict AI route intelligence.

Responsibilities

  • Understand logistics workflows and translate operational problems into ML problem statements.
  • Build, validate, and deploy models for routing, forecasting, anomaly detection, or decision support.
  • Create reusable training pipelines, feature stores, and inference services integrated with Logibee platform APIs.
  • Monitor model performance in production and iterate with product feedback from enterprise customers.
  • Document approaches, trade-offs, and evaluation metrics so teams can trust and extend your work.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and solid grounding in algorithms, data structures, and software architecture.

  • Working knowledge of MongoDB, Postgres, or similar data stores for feature pipelines.
  • Hands-on AWS experience; SageMaker and AWS ML certifications are a plus.
  • Comfort working with remote, cross-functional engineering teams.

Job Summary

We are seeking a versatile AI/ML Engineer to serve as the technical backbone for our Standards & Compliance division. You will build autonomous agents to parse complex 3GPP/TMF specifications, generate compliance documentation, track industry shifts, and streamline our back-office technical operations. Experience: 38 Years

Standards Intelligence & Automation:

  • Develop and deploy Autonomous Agents that ingest, analyse, and summarize massive volumes of technical specifications (3GPP, O-RAN, TMF, ETSI).

  • Automate the creation of technical contributions, liaison statements, and compliance reports using LLM-based agentic workflows.

Back-Office Operational Excellence:

  • Engineer AI solutions to streamline internal back-office workflows, including automated mapping of O-RAN and other SDO requirements to product backlogs.

Technical Implementation:

  • Develop, fine-tune, and deploy ML models that support our orchestration and management (OSS/RAN) strategy.
  • Maintain and scale containerized AI services within Kubernetes (K8s) environments, ensuring high availability for back-office automation tools.
  • Streamline & automate the adoption of various standards to our products and ensure no breaking.

Required Technical Skills

AI/ML & Agentic Frameworks:

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and Agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI).
  • Proven ability to build agents that can reason, plan, and execute tasks across software tools.

Telecom Domain Knowledge:

  • Strong familiarity with OSS/RAN orchestration and key industry frameworks: 3GPP SA5, ETSI MANO, O-RAN Alliance (SMO), TMF Open APIs, and ONAP.
  • Understanding of the CNCF ecosystem and how cloud-native principles apply to telecom.

Programming & Data:

  • Expert-level Python programming.
  • Experience with data extraction, cleaning, and transformation (ETL) from structured and unstructured technical documents.
  • Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases for managing standards-related datasets.

Infrastructure:

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines for deploying AI agents into production.

Must-Haves

  • Automation Portfolio: Demonstrated experience building agents or automation scripts that have significantly reduced manual effort in your previous roles.

Soft Skills

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Software Engineer Platform Engineering to join our engineering organization. You will work closely with software engineers to enhance deployment automation, cloud-native infrastructure, application reliability, developer productivity, and operational excellence.   • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Experience implementing GitOps practices using tools such as ArgoCD.
  • Familiarity with microservices and cloud-native application architecture.
  • Experience with security scanning, vulnerability management, and infrastructure hardening.

We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally.

About Stable Money

Stable Money is Indias leading fixed-income investment platform, on a mission to modernize how 230+ million Indians save and invest. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bengaluru, weve grown to over 30 lakh users who have collectively invested more than 5,000 crore across fixed deposits and other secure instruments, all in under three years.

Backed by $65 million in total institutional funding from marquee investors including Peak XV Partners, Z47, RTP Global, Fundamentum, and Lightspeed, we recently closed a $25 million Pre-Series C round to accelerate our next phase of growth. Were building the operating layer for how India saves making fixed-income products transparent, accessible, and worthy of trust.

Our platform lets users book FDs without opening a savings account, access instant withdrawals, invest in short-term instruments (including 7-day FDs), and discover curated fixed-income portfolios through a digital experience designed around speed and clarity. We are deepening direct partnerships with banks and NBFCs, building on-ground presence in key cities, and expanding into adjacent savings products all while maintaining the trust-first approach that has defined us since day one.

Our Founders

Saurabh Jain is an IIT Bombay graduate who previously served as CEO of Navi Mutual Fund and led Swiggys expansion into 500+ cities.

Harish Reddy , also an IIT Bombay graduate, brings deep expertise in wealth product strategy, having led product strategy and tech implementation at Estee Advisors.

Together, they bring extensive experience in wealth-tech businesses and complement each other in building a scalable, value-accretive business.

Role Purpose

To manage compliance across the Companys Mutual Fund Distribution, Online Bond Platform (OBPP) and Depository Participant businesses, while also managing the Companys internal Company Secretarial function.

The role will be responsible for operational compliance, advertisement and marketing approvals, implementation of regulatory changes, and company secretarial compliance.

1. Key Responsibilities

  1. Investment Product Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable SEBI regulations, AMFI requirements, Mutual Fund Distribution regulations, Online Bond Platform (OBPP) requirements and Depository Participant operational requirements.

  • Monitor regulatory developments and drive implementation of new regulatory requirements across investment products.

  • Develop, maintain and periodically enhance compliance policies, procedures and operational control frameworks.

  • Provide regulatory guidance to Product, Operations, Marketing and Technology teams during product design and implementation.

  • Identify regulatory risks and recommend practical compliance solutions that enable business growth.

  1. Advertisement Review & Product Governance

  • Review and approve marketing campaigns, advertisements and customer communications relating to Mutual Fund Distribution, Bonds and other investment products.

  • Ensure compliance with SEBI, AMFI and applicable advertising guidelines.

  • Review product disclosures, customer communications, website content and promotional material prior to publication.

  • Support launch of new investment products through regulatory assessments and compliance approvals.

  1. Operational Compliance

  • Manage operational compliance across Mutual Fund Distribution, Online Bond Platform and Depository Participant businesses.

  • Review operational processes to identify compliance gaps and recommend process improvements.

  • Monitor implementation of compliance controls across business functions.

  • Support preparation for internal audits and regulatory inspections.

  1. Company Secretarial Function

  • Coordination of Board Meetings and Committee Meetings.

  • Preparation of agendas, Board papers and meeting documentation.

  • Drafting Board and Committee minutes.

  • Maintenance of statutory registers and corporate records.

  • Management of MCA and ROC filings.

  • Annual corporate compliance requirements.

  • Secretarial compliance calendar.

  • Secretarial support across group entities.

  • Liaison with external Company Secretaries, auditors and advisors, where required.

The role will progressively internalise routine company secretarial activities currently managed by external consultants.

Experience & Qualifications

Mandatory Experience

  • 3-4 years of post-qualification experience in Compliance and Company Secretarial functions within securities market regulated entities.

  • Experience in Mutual Fund Distribution, Asset Management Companies, Wealth Management, Stock Broking, Depository Participant or other regulated investment businesses.

  • Experience reviewing customer communications, advertisements and marketing material from a regulatory perspective.

  • Qualified Company Secretary (ACS) preferred.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Design and redesign slides, proposal sections, RFP materials, credentials and case studies to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, structure and readability.
  • Apply Inizio Ignite brand standards, PowerPoint templates, visual systems and document standards consistently.
  • Translate clear briefs and developed content into polished visual outputs, escalating gaps or ambiguity early.
  • Adapt existing materials for different audiences, clients, geographies and pursuit contexts.
  • Create reusable slides, diagrams, icons and data visuals.
  • Work with the design team and the Senior Designer on more complex visual storytelling and priority pursuits.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through design review or independent QA.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, well-named and version-controlled files that are ready for handover and reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly where they improve understanding, exploration or efficiency, while applying independent design judgement to every output.
  • Contribute to asset tagging, template improvement, knowledge capture and shared ways of working.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 2-4 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, visual design or a similar role, ideally supporting proposals, pitches, RFPs or other client-facing materials.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong layout, visual hierarchy, slide design, brand application and the ability to make complex content easier to understand.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills and working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or comparable design tools; Think-cell or other charting experience would be useful.
  • Good understanding of typography, templates, design systems, iconography, data visualisation and document polish.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to ask focused questions when briefs, priorities or source content are incomplete.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams within agreed service levels.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to review, refine or reject AI-assisted suggestions before use.
  • Experience with healthcare, life sciences, consulting or professional-services content would be advantageous.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

Life at Inizio Ignite

You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.

In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.

We provide

  • A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
  • International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
  • A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
  • A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

jobDescription:
About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Own the design and delivery of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority client-facing materials.
  • Translate strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear visual narratives, page structures, diagrams and data stories.
  • Develop credible visual options based on the audience, content maturity, client context and available time.
  • Manage multiple assignments independently, clarify briefs with business stakeholders and flag scope, timing or quality risks early.
  • Apply and reinforce Inizio Ignite brand standards, templates, accessibility requirements and final-file standards.
  • Provide constructive craft feedback and practical support to Designer 1 colleagues, while escalating priority creative decisions to the Senior Designer.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through creative review or independent QA.
  • Create and refine reusable templates, slide components, visual systems, iconography and data-visualisation patterns.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, correctly named and version-controlled files that support reliable handover and future reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate understanding, exploration and production, while ensuring every output is accurate, appropriate and human-reviewed.
  • Contribute to studio standards, onboarding materials, knowledge capture and continuous improvement.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 4+ years of experience in presentation design, visual design, production design or a related creative role, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, consulting, professional services or an agency environment.
  • A strong portfolio showing polished client-facing presentation work, visual storytelling, slide redesign, data visualisation and alternative creative approaches.
  • Advanced PowerPoint skills and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or similar tools; charting experience would be advantageous.
  • Strong command of layout, typography, hierarchy, information design, brand application and final-file quality.
  • Ability to work directly with stakeholders, challenge unclear briefs constructively and manage expectations across several concurrent requests.
  • Experience giving useful craft feedback or supporting the development of less-experienced designers.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to evaluate AI-assisted outputs critically and responsibly.
  • High attention to detail, strong prioritisation and confidence working under time pressure without compromising core quality standards.
  • Ideal profile
  • You can move comfortably between fast-turn production work and more considered visual storytelling.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and know when to involve the Senior Designer or business stakeholder.
  • You enjoy helping others improve and contributing to shared standards, assets and ways of working.
  • You are motivated by the opportunity to shape a new Design Studio and strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

This position works closely with the Legal, Internal Audit, Cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management, and Technology teams to help ensure that contractual, policy, control, procedural, legal, and regulatory obligations are effectively defined and implemented.

  • Develop documentation on how to use GRC and IAM platforms, including platform administration, workflow support, integrations, and recurring compliance processes.
  • Train business partners on how to use GRC and IAM platforms effectively and consistently.
  • Interpret and apply laws, regulations, policies, standards, or procedures to specific issues.
  • Work cooperatively with applicable organization units in implanting consumer information access rights.
  • Serve as a liaison for GRC and IAM platforms to the organization.
  • Monitor systems development and operations for security and privacy compliance

Additional Functions

  • Participate in providing support for compliance-related incidents.
  • Interface with other business units such as Cybersecurity to communicate program status and overall compliance and training posture.
  • Promote a positive security/compliance culture through knowledge sharing, influences, and conduct.
  • Create and maintain role-specific documentation.
  • Assist with our government, risk, and compliance projects as time permits.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of risk/threat assessment.
  • Knowledge of laws, policies, procedures, or governance relevant to Cybersecurity for critical infrastructures.
  • Knowledge of external organizations and academic institutions with a cyber focus (e.g., cyber curriculum/training and Research Development).
  • Knowledge of controls related to data use, processing, storage, and transmission.

  • Skill in conducting information searches.
  • Ability to communicate effectively when writing.
  • Ability to apply critical reading/thinking skills.
  • Interpret and apply laws, regulations, policies, standards, or procedures to specific issues.

  • Provide recommendations for possible improvements and upgrades.
  • Ability to tailor technical and planning information to a customers level of understanding.
  • Ability to work across departments and business units to implement the organization s privacy principles and programs and align privacy objectives with security objectives.

  • 4+ years of relevant experience in Internal Audit, Compliance, or Information Technology

Licenses and Certifications

As a Product & Engineering Operations Manager at Mindtickle, you will play a pivotal role in steering our organization s growth trajectory. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on our company s strategic direction and contribute to our ongoing success in the dynamic world of technology and innovation.
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategy Deployment and Execution
  • Own the overall Roadmap planning exercise. Ensure that the roadmap vision is aligned and an execution plan is in place to ensure initiatives are planned, prioritized, released, and communicated effectively.

  • Plan, track, and measure Goals in R&D. Ensure goals are aligned with leadership, updated on a cadence, and risks are called out proactively.
    • Set up automated dashboards and alerting so risks and blockers surface between review cycles, not just during them.
  • Run horizontal initiatives to bridge process gaps. Identify gaps in the current As-Is process, suggest corrective actions, and work with teams collaboratively to deploy them.
  • Ensure that product and engineering managers have the right tool stack and are using it efficiently. This includes evaluating new tools (including AI-powered developer tools), measuring their impact, and maintaining data hygiene across the stack.
2. Operational Efficiency & Automation
  • Identify repeatable, high-effort operational processes and build lightweight automations to reduce overhead, using low-code tools, scripts, or AI-assisted workflows as appropriate.
    • Examples: automated release notes, sprint summary digests, meeting action-item tracking, intelligent routing of cross-functional requests.
  • Build and maintain internal knowledge systems that make it easy for teams to self-serve on process documentation, past decisions, and institutional knowledge.
3. Support Leadership for Key Initiatives / Meetings
  • Drive key meetings and events, including goal reviews, QBRs, and retrospectives.
  • Program manage key initiatives led by Product & Engineering leadership and provide visibility and progress updates.
  • Assist the leadership team in preparing presentations and documents for board meetings, leadership summits, and customer escalations.

  • Drive or assist in high-priority initiatives as defined in consultation with the COO and Product & Engineering leaders.
  • Assist in cross-team projects as required.
REQUIREMENTS:
  • 4 5 years of total experience in Consulting, Strategy and Operations, CEO/CPO office roles, or with a VC firm with a track record of consistent, outstanding achievements.
  • Track record of working on complex, high-impact projects directly with engineering teams.
  • Has the drive to work in a hands-on operations and strategy role. Comfortable handling ambiguity, shifting gears when needed, and executing without the complete picture.
  • Ability to prototype automations and workflows independently using low-code tools, AI assistants, or scripting without needing to file an engineering ticket for every operational improvement.
  • Data fluency: Comfortable with SQL or BI tools (Looker, Metabase, Tableau) to self-serve on operational analytics rather than waiting on a data team.
  • Be a collaboration catalyst: Ability to create clarity when none exists, learn quickly, take initiative, drive complex projects, and get things done.
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively both verbally and in writing across stakeholders and C-level executives.
  • Strong demonstrated experience in establishing processes across the organization.
  • Familiarity with the software product development lifecycle and related processes.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: Drives projects on a cadence through collaboration, not authority.
NICE TO HAVE:
  • Experience with change management when rolling out new tools or processes to engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo) and how to leverage them for roadmap decisions.
  • Prior experience in a SaaS or B2B product company.
  • Exposure to OKR frameworks and modern goal-setting methodologies.

jobDescription:
As a Resource Management Specialist within Radancys Global Delivery Center (GDC), you will play a critical role in ensuring our global delivery teams have the right people assigned to the right work at the right time.
Working across Digital, Creative and Customer Delivery teams, you will coordinate resource allocation throughout the full project lifecycle, partnering closely with Project Managers, Customer Success, Delivery Managers and functional leaders to balance customer demand, skills, capacity and business priorities.
You will help maximise utilisation, identify project blockers before they impact delivery, and provide the visibility needed to ensure projects are delivered efficiently and successfully for customers across the globe.
This is a highly collaborative role requiring excellent organisational skills, commercial awareness and the ability to work across multiple regions, teams and priorities in a fast-paced SaaS environment.
Responsibilities
Resource Planning Allocation
  • Own day-to-day resource allocation across Digital, Creative and Customer Delivery teams.
  • Assign resources based on skills, availability, customer priorities and project requirements.
  • Coordinate resource assignments across the full project lifecycle, from project initiation through to delivery and post-launch support.
  • Continuously monitor project demand and adjust resource plans as priorities change.
  • Balance workloads across global teams to maximise utilisation while maintaining delivery quality.
Capacity Demand Management
  • Maintain accurate resource schedules and forward-looking capacity plans.
  • Monitor utilisation across teams and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Identify project blockers, scheduling conflicts and delivery risks early.
  • Escalate capacity or delivery issues with clear recommendations and mitigation plans.
Project Delivery Support
  • Partner with Project Managers to understand upcoming demand, milestones and delivery timelines.
  • Validate resource availability before project commitments are made.
  • Support changes resulting from scope updates, customer priorities or project delays.
  • Help ensure projects remain appropriately staffed throughout delivery.
Operational Excellence
  • Maintain accurate resource allocation data within resource planning and project management systems.
  • Produce regular reporting on utilisation, capacity, forecasting and demand.
  • Support continuous improvement of resource management processes and planning practices.
  • Promote consistent global resource management standards across delivery teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve planning, scheduling and operational efficiency.
Collaboration
  • Act as the central coordination point between Project Management, Customer Success, Creative, Digital Delivery and functional leadership.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across multiple regions.
  • Facilitate conversations to resolve resource conflicts while balancing customer needs and business priorities.
  • Communicate resource availability, risks and changes clearly to delivery stakeholders.
Qualifications
Essential
  • 4+ years experience in Resource Management, Traffic Management, Workforce Planning, Project Coordination or a similar operational role.
  • Experience supporting multiple concurrent projects within a SaaS, technology, digital business or professional services environment.
  • Strong organisational and planning skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to manage competing priorities within a fast-paced global environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret utilisation, forecasting and capacity data.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with good knowledge of Microsoft Office.
  • Experience using project management and/or resource planning tools.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.
Desirable
  • Experience supporting global or distributed teams.
  • Experience working within Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  • Understanding of digital delivery, creative production or software implementation projects.
  • Experience working with offshore or global delivery centres.
Work Location
Hybrid Work Model: This is a hybrid position, requiring you to work in the Bengaluru office 3 times per week.

jobDescription:
DAU invites applications from outstanding candidates for faculty positions in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at the Assistant Professor and Associate Professor levels.

While applications from all areas of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence are welcome, the University is particularly interested in candidates with expertise in the following domains:

  • Computer Systems and Networking: Operating Systems; Computer Networks; Distributed Systems; Cloud Computing; High-Performance Computing.
  • Software Engineering and Data Management: Databases; Data Mining; Data Warehousing; Software Design and Architecture; System Analysis and Design; Code Analysis and Software Quality Assurance; Software Testing and Verification.
  • Human Computer Interaction and Interactive Technologies: Human Computer Interaction (HCI); User Experience (UX) and User Interface (UI) Design; Cognitive Computing; Interaction Design; Intelligent and Adaptive Interfaces; Game Design and Development.
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Machine Learning; Deep Learning; Adversarial Machine Learning; Quantum Machine Learning; Multimodal Learning; Responsible and Trustworthy AI; Reinforcement Learning; Federated Learning; Artificial Intelligence and Ethics.
  • Natural Language Processing and Information Retrieval: Natural Language Processing (NLP); Large Language Models (LLMs); Knowledge Representation and Reasoning; Information Retrieval and Search Technologies.

Minimum Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must satisfy the following minimum requirements:

  • A Ph.D. degree in a relevant discipline, with a First Class or equivalent grade in the preceding degree(s), and an excellent academic record throughout; and
  • A strong and sustained research record, evidenced by publications in reputed peer-reviewed journals and leading international conferences.

Assistant Professor

Applicants should possess a Ph.D. degree, demonstrated research potential, and a strong commitment to excellence in teaching at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Candidates with postdoctoral research experience and evidence of independent research capability will be given preference.

Associate Professor

Applicants should have a minimum of six years of post-Ph.D. experience in teaching, research, or relevant professional practice, of which at least three years should be at the level of Assistant Professor (or an equivalent position) at a higher educational institution or research organization.

Candidates are expected to have an established record of scholarly achievement, demonstrated through:

  • High-quality publications in reputed journals and conferences;
  • Success in securing externally funded research grants and projects;
  • Experience in supervising doctoral students and mentoring research scholars; and
  • Evidence of academic leadership and professional contributions to the discipline.

Industry Professionals

The University also welcomes applications from candidates with significant industry experience and a strong research and innovation profile. Professionals who have made substantial contributions to research, product development, technology innovation, or industrial RD and are passionate about teaching and mentoring students are encouraged to apply.

The University particularly values candidates who can bridge academia and industry through collaborative research, technology transfer, entrepreneurship, and experiential learning initiatives.

Salary per year in Cost to the Institute (CTI) format

Assistant Professor: Minimum starting salary is 20 Lakh per annum.
(Exceptionally qualified and experienced candidates may be considered for higher compensation and additional incentives commensurate with their credentials, achievements, and potential contributions.)

Perquisites Benefits

Research Support and Professional Development

  • Seed Research Grant: Up to 10 Lakh to support the establishment of research activities and laboratory infrastructure.
  • Professional Development Allowance: A cumulative allowance of 3 Lakh every three years (on a reimbursable basis) to support participation in national and international conferences, workshops, and other professional development activities.
  • Research Excellence Incentive: Financial reward of 1 Lakh for each publication in top-tier A/A-ranked conferences and Q1 journals.

Health, Insurance and Other Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance: Health insurance coverage of up to 10 Lakh per annum for the faculty member and eligible family members under a floater policy. The entire premium is borne by the Institute.
  • OPD medical reimbursement: 5000 per month for OPD medical expenses.
  • Children Education Allowances: 50000 per year ( 25000 per child, and coverage up to two children.)
  • Leave Travel Concession: 1.5 Lakh for a 4-year block.
  • Interest free loan up to 5 Lakh.
  • On-campus medical facilities, including visiting doctors and access to basic medicines through the University s Medical Centre.

Leave and Work-Life Balance

  • Casual Leave: 8 days per year.
  • Special Casual Leave: 15 days per year.
  • Vacation: Up to 60 days of vacation annually. Unavailed vacation is converted to earned leave (up to 30 days per year).
  • Earned Leave Encashment: Accumulated earned leave is encashable upon separation from the University, as per applicable policies.

Career Growth

  • Career Progression (Policy): A transparent and well-defined faculty career advancement framework that recognizes excellence in teaching, research, and institutional service.
  • Teaching Load: Faculty members typically teach three courses per academic year. To facilitate a smooth transition, newly appointed faculty members are assigned a reduced teaching load of two courses during their first year (one course per semester).

Research Collaboration and Industry Engagement

DAU actively encourages faculty members to pursue collaborative research and innovation initiatives with leading academic institutions, research laboratories, government agencies, and industry partners in India and abroad. The University provides a supportive environment for securing external research funding, undertaking interdisciplinary projects, and translating research outcomes into societal and industrial impact.

The learnings that youll get through training, speaking to experts on the one hand, and simplifying concepts for beginners on the other hand, will enable you to consult on running better campaigns, which in turn will help you train better.   • Ability to simplify complex ideas and communicate their essence to new audiences
  • A willingness to add value to every partner you come across.
  • A structured, data-driven, user-centric approach to problem-solving

Good-To-Haves:

  • Experience in driving growth for brands on Quick-commerce platforms like BlinkIt / Zepto
  • Inventory forecasting planning, and PL management of a category

Gurgaon
